My dear [Sir William](/person/669)
Thank you greatly, I thought just as you do that it was rather a needless question since I was quite sure of the fact of what [Mr. Keble](/person/798)said to me, and I should not have asked you if it had been any one else who advised me, but having asked [him](/person/1015) it seemed wrong not to do just what he told me.
[Miss Dyson](/person/464) is a devoted lover of [King Charles](/person/1768), and had been vexed to see any words of Mr. Keble used against him. Besides she said, and truly, that Mr. Keble's chance conversational sayings did not always reflect a deliberate opinion, and the point was whether this did or not reckon as an opinion thought out and considered, which is my decided impression.

Yours affectionately
C. M. Yonge
